mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, ug.grade_id AS gradeId, ug.grade_name AS gradeName, ug.monthly_price AS monthlyPrice, ug.monthly_chat_limit AS monthlyChatLimit, ug.monthly_phone_limit AS monthlyPhoneLimit, ug.monthly_chat_phone_limit AS monthlyChatPhoneLimit, ug.monthly_inquiry_limit AS monthlyInquiryLimit, ug.diet_review_yn AS dietReviewYn, ug.diary_report_yn AS diaryReportYn, ug.premium_content_yn AS premiumContentYn, ug.full_video_yn AS fullVideoYn, ug.carryover_yn AS carryoverYn, ug.weekly_report_yn AS weeklyReportYn, ms.subscription_status AS subscriptionStatus, ms.start_date AS startDate, ms.end_date AS endDate, ms.next_billing_date AS nextBillingDate, ms.auto_renew_yn AS autoRenewYn FROM member m JOIN user_grade ug ON ug.grade_id = m.grade_id LEFT JOIN membership_subscription ms ON ms.member_id = m.member_id AND ms.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT mu.member_id AS memberId, mu.usage_month AS usageMonth, mu.grade_id AS gradeId, mu.chat_used_count AS chatUsedCount, mu.phone_used_count AS phoneUsedCount, mu.chat_phone_used_count AS chatPhoneUsedCount, mu.inquiry_used_count AS inquiryUsedCount, mu.carryover_chat_phone_count AS carryoverChatPhoneCount,
GREATEST(ug.monthly_chat_limit - mu.chat_used_count, 0) AS remainChatCount, GREATEST(ug.monthly_phone_limit - mu.phone_used_count, 0) AS remainPhoneCount, GREATEST((ug.monthly_chat_phone_limit + mu.carryover_chat_phone_count) - mu.chat_phone_used_count, 0) AS remainChatPhoneCount, GREATEST(ug.monthly_inquiry_limit - mu.inquiry_used_count, 0) AS remainInquiryCount FROM membership_usage_monthly mu JOIN user_grade ug ON ug.grade_id = mu.grade_id WHERE mu.member_id = #{memberId} AND mu.usage_month = #{usageMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_usage_monthly ( member_id, usage_month, grade_id, chat_used_count, phone_used_count, chat_phone_used_count, inquiry_used_count, carryover_chat_phone_count ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{usageMonth}, #{gradeId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 )
